task: Profile genome-wide protein occupancy on bacterial DNA to identify condition-dependent gene regulation changes
key_results: IPOD-HR enables identification of protein-bound genomic regions and condition/genotype-dependent changes in occupancy; core protocol requires 3 calendar days post-crosslinking
comments: IPOD-HR overcomes nucleoid-associated protein interference that limits ATAC-seq applicability in bacteria, but requires standard molecular biology expertise and Linux command-line proficiency.

model_io.model: IPOD-HR protocol coupled to RNA polymerase ChIP

hypotheses.hypothesis: Genome-wide protein occupancy can be comprehensively profiled without individual ChIP-seq experiments for each protein
hypotheses.result: IPOD-HR successfully identifies protein-bound regions and genotype/condition-dependent occupancy
